reason: The README clearly describes a DeepSeek Harness plugin for configuring, routing, templating, and continuing delegated subagents, so orchestration is the primary user-facing purpose.

summaries.zh: 为 DeepSeek Harness 配置子代理的模型路由、角色模板、委派行为和可续聊后台执行。
summaries.en: Configures DeepSeek Harness subagent model routing, role templates, delegation behavior, and continuable background execution.

capabilities: Configures per-subagent LLM providers and models
Applies role templates with descriptions and personas to delegated subagents
Supports background and continuable subagent execution
Provides a settings interface and HTTP bridge for configuration
Injects delegation guidance into the main agent prompt
